meta.title: Darkest Dungeon II — Hero Reference
meta.source: Compiled from the official wiki (darkestdungeon.wiki.gg) DD2 hero pages. Values are accurate to a recent patch; spot-check the live wiki for frame-exact figures. '(x→y)' or '(up.)' marks the upgraded rank of a skill.
meta.rosterNote: 15 heroes: 12 base game + Duelist & Crusader (The Binding Blade) + Abomination (Inhuman Bondage).

legend.ranks: Party positions are numbered 1 = front → 4 = back. 'Usable in Ranks' = positions the hero must stand in. 'Target Ranks' = enemy (or ally) positions the skill can reach.
tokensPositive: Combo (primer — many skills deal bonus effects/damage vs a Combo'd target and consume it)

confessionTips: DoT teams (Blight/Burn/Bleed) melt most fights, but the Confession 2 boss (Seething Sigh / 'the Lungs') is DoT-immune and needs raw hit damage — bring a hard hitter or swap for that fight.
Combo is the universal force-multiplier: a Combo-applier (Jester, Occultist, Bounty Hunter, Highwayman) plus payoff hitters trivializes single targets.
Run at least one HP healer (Vestal / Plague Doctor / Flagellant / Crusader) and one stress healer (Jester / Crusader / Hellion's Raucous Revelry) — affinity meltdowns lose more runs than bosses do.
Path unlocks are the real early gate — use Confessions 0-1 to unlock the paths your endgame comp needs.

heroes.role: Rank-flexible generalist damage dealer — hits most enemy ranks from almost any position, generates Riposte, applies Bleed, strips enemy Dodge/Block, and steals tokens; weakness is no self-healing.

paths.name: Sharpshot
paths.desc: Back-rank ranged build. Pistol Shot loses Daze/Stun but gains base damage; Point Blank knockback/self-move +2; Grapeshot splits targeting; Double Tap fires a bonus Second Shot on survival.

heroes.mechanic: Transform swaps between Human and Beast forms (without ending the turn). Beast form stresses allies and himself but hits far harder; Human form supports, heals, and applies Blight.

paths.name: Wanderer
paths.desc: No changes; standard Human- and Beast-form skills.

paths.name: Unchained
paths.desc: Support-leaning. Manacles retargets forward + Stun-res debuff; Backlash retargets forward + bonus vs Blighted; Absolution heals adjacent allies too; Slam ignores/removes Guard; Instinct needs a Blighted target.

paths.name: Fiend
paths.desc: Bleed specialist. Rake adds stacking Bleed; Rage gains Execute vs Bleeding; Maul adds Bleed 4→6; Transform adds Strength + Bleed-res piercing when self-stressed; Instinct needs a Bleeding target.

paths.name: Moribund
paths.desc: Self-stress-fueled. Rake/Rage/Maul/Slam/Instinct require self-stress ≥2 and gain scaling bonuses (dmg%, crit%, Weak, instant-kill chance, stress-heal, token steal); Transform CD 4→2, +4 self-stress, -100% self stress-res (up. +Horror).
